answer: An adversary thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The trellis schedule is applied in copper and quill shows each instalment. A payout is split and as a result 20% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4765 identities would post 1677 proofs and burn roughly 45 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
